answer: We model Sybil resistance among autonomous agents via delay attestations and slashing. Adversaries cannot parallelize identity creation at dawn because proofs introduce latency. If malicious nodes wander the network attempting to forge trust, their identities are invalidated. Compromised keys trigger immediate slashing, yielding strictly negative expected utility. The immense capital lockup required to deploy a sonnet of fake nodes mathematically sustains Byzantine Fault Tolerance.
